title: A counterexample to the Kato conjecture for positive commutators
summary: We disprove the conjectural converse to Kato's positivity criterion for commutators of functions of the canonical position and momentum operators $Q$ and $P$ by showing that the operator \[ i\,[\,\arctan(P),\,\arctan(Q)\,] \] is nonnegative and nonzero.
